# IMinimalVestingWallet
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/IMinimalVestingWallet.sol)

this is a minimal vesting wallet interface


## Functions
### balanceOf

the balance of the vesting wallet can only go down - if it goes up - tokens were sent to the wallet
(unintended bhavior)


```solidity
function balanceOf(address _user) external view returns (uint256);
```

### owner

the current owner of the vesting wallet ( might be different that owner in the factory contract)


```solidity
function owner() external view returns (address);
```

### transferOwnership

the ownership of the vesting wallet can be trnsfered - this is used to transfer the ownership of the
vesting wallet to the user


```solidity
function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external;
```

### released

the amount of tokens released from the vesting wallet


```solidity
function released(address _token) external view returns (uint256);
```
